A '''powered spear''' was a [[Melee weapon/Legends|melee weapon]].

==Description==
Powered spears were around the same height as the Patitites and produced an electrical charge mainly to harm [[Droid/Legends|droids]].

==History==
Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a battle took place near the planet of [[Patitite Pattuna/Legends|Patitite Pattuna]] and ended up with the [[Protocol droid/Legends|Protocol droid]] [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and his [[Astromech droid/Legends|Astromech droid]] accomplice [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] crash landing on the surface. These spears were used by the [[Patitite/Legends|Patitites]] to hold down the droids moments after landing.
